title: GUIDE: Computationally Augmented Consensus for Trustworthy Clinical Practice Guidelines
abstract: arXiv:2610.16108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Maintaining up-to-date clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) is essential for evidence-based medicine, but rapid evidence growth and complex expert consensus formation limit timely updates. We developed GUIDE, a multi-agent copilot system for human-AI collaborative guideline generation and updating. GUIDE delegates labor-intensive tasks to specialized AI agents while preserving expert judgment and final arbitration. In 12 NICE ophthalmology datasets, GUIDE achieved 88.85% literature recall, 86.06% alignment in certainty-of-evidence ratings, and 91.67% recommendation agreement, requiring 162.17 minutes per dataset on average (28.68% human intervention). Performance remained stable across 20 additional datasets from cardiology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, and respiratory medicine. translated_title: GUIDE：面向可信临床实践指南的计算增强共识
translated_abstract: 保持临床实践指南（CPGs）的及时更新对循证医学至关重要，但证据的快速增长和复杂的专家共识形成过程限制了指南的及时更新。我们开发了GUIDE，一个用于人机协作指南生成与更新的多智能体副驾驶系统。GUIDE将劳动密集型任务委派给专门的AI智能体，同时保留专家判断和最终裁决权。在12个NICE眼科数据集上，GUIDE实现了88.85%的文献召回率、86.06%的证据确定性评级一致性以及91.67%的推荐意见一致性，平均每个数据集需要162.17分钟（人类干预占28.68%）。在来自心脏病学、内分泌学、胃肠病学和呼吸医学的另外20个数据集上，性能保持稳定。消融分析表明，移除专家干预会降低偏倚风险评估等判断密集型步骤中的表现。在六个知识截止日期后的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GUIDE是一个人机协作的多智能体副驾驶系统，通过AI智能体承担文献检索等劳动密集型任务并保留专家最终判断权，在临床实践指南的生成与更新中实现了高文献召回率、高证据评级一致性和高推荐意见一致性，且性能在不同科室间保持稳定。
en_tdlr: GUIDE is a human-AI multi-agent copilot system that delegates labor-intensive tasks to specialized AI agents while preserving expert judgment and final arbitration, achieving high literature recall, evidence-rating consistency, and recommendation agreement for trustworthy clinical practice guideline generation and updating across multiple specialties.
